issue.title: Fix loopback address for REST API gateway (v2)

repository.name: prometheus
repository.description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.

issue.body:
This pull request for `dev-2.0` (not `master`) resolves #3149 and resolves #3004 by replacing zero listen-addresses (`0.0.0.0`, `::`, `""`) with `localhost` before passing it to the client for the REST API gateway.

CC: @fabxc

body: I created Pull Request #3174 that fixes this issue (at least, for me)
